Shoppers check their order status 3 to 4 times, yet most pages offer zero path to a second purchase.

protect the revenue you’ve already earned through successful checkout.

returns into branded moments that drive repeat revenue and build deep trust.

## Alias Collection Book

The new Collection Book is much more than a catalogue: it is a visual and design narrative of Alias'
identity.
A journey spanning over forty-five years of research, culture and experimentation, intertwining
iconic products and new collections, established visions and emerging perspectives.

[Explore the catalogue][94]

## Projects

Alias’s projects arise from the fusion of aesthetic research, functionality and innovation. From
private homes to public spaces, from contemporary offices to outdoor environments, each project
reflects the brand identity through versatile and timeless solutions.
We collaborate with architects, designers and companies to create unique settings that enhance
architecture and offer new comfort and beauty experiences.

## Alias Collection Book

The new Collection Book is much more than a catalogue: it is a visual and design narrative of Alias'
identity.
A journey spanning over forty-five years of research, culture and experimentation, intertwining
iconic products and new collections, established visions and emerging perspectives.

[Explore the catalogue][94]

## Projects

Alias’s projects arise from the fusion of aesthetic research, functionality and innovation. From
private homes to public spaces, from contemporary offices to outdoor environments, each project
reflects the brand identity through versatile and timeless solutions.
We collaborate with architects, designers and companies to create unique settings that enhance
architecture and offer new comfort and beauty experiences.

## Looking for Something Else?

Alias’ multifaceted spirit is reflected in numerous projects involving a complementary team,
emphasising the intellectual value of the brand and embracing open experimentation of forms,
materials, and languages. Discover exclusive contributions highlighting the dual nature of Alias, in
a synergy between functionality and artistry, in pursuit of Something Else.

[Find out more][98]

## In the spotlight

All Alias products enrich the habitat with their strongly expressive essentiality. A catalogue in
continuous evolution, with the constant ability to meet the real demands of contemporary living,
working and dwelling.

# Your Daily Dose Of Inspiration And Knowledge

Daily Insights And Inspiration to Fuel Your Mind, Creativity And Personal Growth.

[Smart Saving Tips: Spend Less, Save More & Grow Your Wealth]

**Smart Saving Tips: Spend Less, Save More & Grow Your Wealth:** Imagine this: it’s the end of the
month, bills are paid, and instead of feeling broke, you have extra money sitting in your account.
Feels good, right? That’s what smart saving is all about — creating a life where you’re not stressed
about every purchase. Saving doesn’t mean living a boring, joyless life. It means making thoughtful
choices, spending with intention, and setting yourself up for a future where money isn’t a constant
worry. Track Before You Tweak Before you can save, you need to know where your cash is actually
going. For one month, track everything — yes, even that “small” coffee on the way to work. Once
you’ve tracked it all, divide your spending into three buckets: Needs: rent, groceries, utilities
Wants: entertainment, eating out, shopping Savings/Debt: investments, loan payments, emergency fund
You’ll probably notice patterns right away — like how eating out three times a week adds up to more
than you expected. This step alone can uncover hundreds of dollars of potential savings. Build a
Budget You’ll Actually Use A budget isn’t a punishment — it’s a plan. Try the 50/30/20 rule: 50% of
your income for needs 30% for wants 20% for savings If 20% sounds impossible right now, start with
5–10%. The key is to get started and adjust as your income grows. Small, steady progress beats
perfection.  Pay Yourself First Most people save what’s left after spending. Flip the script. The
moment your paycheck lands, move a chunk into savings — automatically if possible. Think of it as
paying a bill to your future self. This habit builds wealth without requiring constant discipline.
 Shop With Intention Smart saving isn’t about never buying nice things — it’s about buying them
deliberately. For example, if you’ve been browsing an Adidas Shoes Review: Latest Trends & Buying
Guide, don’t just click “buy now.” Wait for a seasonal sale, check multiple stores, and use cashback
apps to stretch your money further. This way, you still get what you want — but without draining
your wallet.  Compare Before You Commit Impulse buys are sneaky. A quick search before purchasing
can save serious money. Websites like Dealspotbay are helpful for this. They collect prices from
multiple retailers, so you can quickly see where the best deal is — no endless tab-hopping required.
This small habit alone can save hundreds every year.  Build an Emergency Fund Life happens — jobs
change, cars break, medical bills appear out of nowhere. Your emergency fund is your financial
safety net. Aim for at least three months of living expenses in a separate savings account. When
life throws you a curveball, this money keeps you from swiping your credit card and going into debt.
 Attack High-Interest Debt If you carry credit card balances, make paying them off a priority.
Interest rates can be brutal and eat up money that could be saved. Try the avalanche method (tackle
the highest interest first) or the snowball method (pay off the smallest debt first for quick wins).
Once you’re debt-free, redirect those payments into savings. Automate Everything You Can Willpower
is overrated. Automate bill payments, savings transfers, and even investments. The less you have to
think about it, the more consistent you’ll be. Boost Your Income Cutting costs can only go so far.
Look for ways to earn extra income — freelance work, a part-time gig, or even selling unused items
at home—every extra dollar speeds up your progress.  Invest Early, Even in Small Amounts Saving is
step one, but investing is where wealth really grows. Open a retirement account, start with index
funds or ETFs, and contribute regularly. Thanks to compound interest, even small contributions can
turn into a surprising sum over time. Practice the Pause Before you buy anything, pause and ask
yourself: Do I really need this? Can I find it cheaper?  Will I still be satisfied with my purchase
next month? This 10-second pause is powerful — it stops impulse purchases before they happen.  Keep
Learning Money management is a lifelong skill. Read finance blogs, listen to podcasts, and stay
updated on new tools that make saving easier. The more you know, the better choices you make.
Conclusion: Smart saving is about progress, not perfection. Each good decision — tracking your
expenses, paying yourself first, comparing prices before you buy — is a building block toward
financial freedom. Even small habits, like waiting for discounts after reading a shoe review or
checking prices on Dealspotbay, compound over time. Start today, stay consistent, and watch your
savings grow into a life you actually want to live.

BEAUNITY unites hundreds of suppliers of professional beauty products

with distributors, representatives of salon business, cosmetologists, and aestheticians.

BEAUTY — IS OUR DUTY


BEAUNITY helps to effectively and quickly introduce your products, methods, technologies, and
equipment to increase loyalty and awareness of your brand, expand the geography of sales and create
professional community around your brand.

Facts & Figures
Take advantage of our scale!
* 300+
  Russian and foreign manufacturers of professional cosmetics, products, accessories and equipment
  for salons and clinics
* 23 000+
  Beauty professionals at the most authoritative platform for beauty business leaders, private
  specialists and doctors
* 4000+
  Attendees of the Congress and great conference program
* 200+
  Hours of unique content for beauty specialists and doctors
RUSSIAN MARKET
Russian consumers spend approximately $3.9 billion on cosmetology services.

+20% — annual growth of the aesthetic medicine market in Russia
+46% — increase in the number of cosmetology procedures
76,000+ — beauty salons and clinics across Russia
11.5 million — injection procedures performed in Russia (+32% YoY)
~10% CAGR (2026–2030) — medical aesthetics market growth

## What you will get during 3 exhibition days
* ### CONCENTRATION OF PROFESSIONALS
  
  your potential clients in the field of aesthetics and health, representatives of distributing
  companies, beauty salons, clinics, SPA and wellness
* ### GREAT BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES
  
  This show is a shortest way to enter Russian beauty & cosmetology market, find end customers or
  distributors, increase sales turnover and raise awareness about your brand
* ### VISUAL DEMONSTRATION
  
  of innovations, products, equipment and apparatus cosmetology, masterclasses for thousands of
  specialists
* ### ADVANTAGES OF F-TO-F MEETINGS
  
  personal communication and negotiations with decision makers

Offer your solutions and products to those who need it!

## Book a stand at BEAUNITY by InterCHARM

Participation cost is not only about square meters.
What do we mean by the cost, and what do you get?
* High level and professionalism of the visitor audience
* Impeccable organisation from professionals of the exhibition industry
* Full promotion of your brands and products among our visitors
* Effective advertising and promotion opportunities to highlight your brand

exhibition

* **Beauty Machines & Devices**

  * Laser systems

* **Aesthetic Medicine**
  * Dermal fillers
  * Skin boosters
  * Mesotherapy & ampoules

* **Salon & Clinic Furniture + Equipment**

* **Hair & Scalp Care (Trichology)**

  * Professional accessories
* **Spa, Massage & Wellness + Professional Supplies**

Moving Animal Healthcare Forward

[Learn More][11]

Laboratory Research Equipment

With over 20 years of experience in the research industry, DRE Veterinary is a trusted leader
dedicated to advancing scientific discovery. We are proud to be associated with AALAS and have
collaborated on projects with every major university, NIH, VA, and foreign governments. Our team of
experts specializes in the research field and is committed to providing tailored advice to meet all
your research needs. Reach out to one of our specialists today and let us help you achieve your
research goals.

[Learn More][12]

Bioskills Lab

DRE Veterinary offers a wide range of products to create realistic biolabs and simulation centers.
Whether for training, veterinary education, R&D, or OEM needs, our experienced team can help you
design and build the perfect environment. Let our product planners assist you in bringing your
simulation center to life.

[Learn More][13]

Equine and Large Animal Specialists

Based in Kentucky—the equine capital of the world—DRE Veterinary brings extensive experience in the
equine industry. Our team of experts is dedicated to helping you design and build state-of-the-art
equine ORs and facilities. Trust us to provide the knowledge and solutions you need for a successful
equine practice.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

returns to all stakeholders — from the public, founders, foundations, and nonprofits to financial

cGMP-integrated contract research, development, and manufacturing organization. Esco Aster operates
two dedicated certified sites: one focused on clinical medicine, veterinary medicine, and

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][66]

Advancing the Future of Medicine Through Innovation


At Esco Aster, we empower the development of next-generation medicines by combining advanced
bioprocess solutions, translational research, and scalable manufacturing support. From discovery to
commercialization, we help innovators accelerate breakthroughs in biologics, cell and gene therapy,
vaccines, and regenerative medicine.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][67]

Enabling Next-Generation Clinical Nutritional Solutions


Esco Aster provides cell-based products and derivatives for clinical and functional nutrition. These
include cell-based meats, proteins, fatty acids, collagen, and other high-value ingredients such as
bird’s nest, deer antler, mitochondria, and milk-/plant-derived extracellular vesicles for
nutraceuticals and supplements.

These products are developed for both companion animals and humans, ensuring clinical benefits for
improved skin health and gut microbiome function. This enables precision nutrition for cancer
patients as well as wellness and longevity applications aimed at increasing health span, not just
lifespan.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

# YOUR COMPLETE SUPPLY AND SOLUTIONS PARTNER

Eurovets is the trusted name in providing veterinary and animal health products, proudly serving
clinics and businesses throughout UAE and the greater Gulf region for the past two decades.

We offer a comprehensive premium product range at highly competitive prices from small to large
animal practices. It includes items such as diagnostics, nutritionals, medicines, feed, equipment,
consumables and more.

[Download][14] our latest corporate brochure.

## Our Services

Eurovets aspires to be more than just a distributor of veterinary medicine and animal health
products in Dubai. We strive to add value to the client's business and raise industry standards
locally. The outstanding services and value added business solutions which differentiate us include:

[Importer][15]

We source and import the highest quality, cutting edge, value-laden products to meet the needs of
our veterinary, pet, agricultural, equine and camel market across the UAE.

[Facilities][16]

Eurovets warehouses and distributes over 2000+ products from two strategically located facilities.
Products are stored in certified temperature controlled warehouses and dispatched in accordance to
our client’s needs and expectations. Our warehouses are supported by a service and sales office.

[Logistics and Fleet][17]

Our Temperature controlled fleet of vehicles and Truck combined with state of the art inventory
management system allows us to timeously deliver products to our customers. This include deliveries
from clinics, pet shops to stables, farms and royal palaces.

[Brand Management and Marketing][18]

Communicating the value of the products we distribute is at the heart of our sales and marketing
efforts. We provide various online and print marketing support material for the brands and products
we represent and distribute in the UAE.

[Seminars and CPD training][19]

Continuing Professional Development (CPD) is an on-going learning process that ensures veterinarians
and health care professionals enhance their knowledge base and clinical skills throughout their
working lives. We provide seminars and events that deliver practical and relevant knowledge -
 making learning convenient and enjoyable.

[Aftermarket software and technical support][20]

Our In-House Field Technical Support team provides: Equipment onsite installation, maintenance,
software updates, and staff training.

# YOUR COMPLETE SUPPLY AND SOLUTIONS PARTNER

Eurovets is the trusted name in providing veterinary and animal health products, proudly serving
clinics and businesses throughout UAE and the greater Gulf region for the past two decades.

We offer a comprehensive premium product range at highly competitive prices from small to large
animal practices. It includes items such as diagnostics, nutritionals, medicines, feed, equipment,
consumables and more.

[Download][14] our latest corporate brochure.

## Our Services

Eurovets aspires to be more than just a distributor of veterinary medicine and animal health
products in Dubai. We strive to add value to the client's business and raise industry standards
locally. The outstanding services and value added business solutions which differentiate us include:

[Importer][15]

We source and import the highest quality, cutting edge, value-laden products to meet the needs of
our veterinary, pet, agricultural, equine and camel market across the UAE.

[Facilities][16]

Eurovets warehouses and distributes over 2000+ products from two strategically located facilities.
Products are stored in certified temperature controlled warehouses and dispatched in accordance to
our client’s needs and expectations. Our warehouses are supported by a service and sales office.

[Logistics and Fleet][17]

Our Temperature controlled fleet of vehicles and Truck combined with state of the art inventory
management system allows us to timeously deliver products to our customers. This include deliveries
from clinics, pet shops to stables, farms and royal palaces.

[Brand Management and Marketing][18]

Communicating the value of the products we distribute is at the heart of our sales and marketing
efforts. We provide various online and print marketing support material for the brands and products
we represent and distribute in the UAE.

[Seminars and CPD training][19]

Continuing Professional Development (CPD) is an on-going learning process that ensures veterinarians
and health care professionals enhance their knowledge base and clinical skills throughout their
working lives. We provide seminars and events that deliver practical and relevant knowledge -
 making learning convenient and enjoyable.

[Aftermarket software and technical support][20]

Our In-House Field Technical Support team provides: Equipment onsite installation, maintenance,
software updates, and staff training.

**ABOUT GROOMER TO GROOMER**

## The Leading Publication for the Pet Grooming Industry

As the leading authority in the pet care and grooming industry, Groomer to Groomer serves as the
essential lifeline for professional pet stylists, mobile groomers, and salon owners who view
grooming as both a high-level craft and a dedicated business.

Whether you are navigating the complexities of staff retention, seeking the latest ergonomic tools
to prevent career-ending physical strain, or looking for marketing strategies to attract high-value
clientele, Groomer to Groomer is designed to speak your language.

You aren’t just a service provider; you are a trusted advisor whose expertise pet parents rely on
for everything from skin health to product recommendations. Groomer to Groomer provides the
technical and business acumen to uphold your rapport.

**ABOUT GROOMER TO GROOMER**

## The Leading Publication for the Pet Grooming Industry

As the leading authority in the pet care and grooming industry, Groomer to Groomer serves as the
essential lifeline for professional pet stylists, mobile groomers, and salon owners who view
grooming as both a high-level craft and a dedicated business.

Whether you are navigating the complexities of staff retention, seeking the latest ergonomic tools
to prevent career-ending physical strain, or looking for marketing strategies to attract high-value
clientele, Groomer to Groomer is designed to speak your language.

You aren’t just a service provider; you are a trusted advisor whose expertise pet parents rely on
for everything from skin health to product recommendations. Groomer to Groomer provides the
technical and business acumen to uphold your rapport.

[

### Anton

Classic and contemporary, the Anton Collection features plush seating, curved lines and a low
profile to help maximize your comfort.

[

### Braxton

Button tufting and matching bolsters brings retro elegance into your space with this Mid-Century
inspired collection.

][128]
[

### Briar

A classic Mid-Century frame, hallmarked by its tufted bench seat, bolster pillows and plush comfort.

][129]
[

### Bryant

The ultimate in cloud-like comfort, Bryant Collection brings a pillow topped way to lounge straight
to your living room.

][130]
[

### Chelsea

Blending the best of modern and classic designs, the Chelsea Collection showcases timeless tufted
detailing and gold capped legs for a touch of elegance.

][131]
[

### Eastwood

Strikingly sleek with all the best Mid-Century angles on display, the Eastwood Collection provides
comfortable seating with all the best retro vibes.

][132]
[

### Eliot

Sleek Mid-Century lines and tufted button detailing gives this collection a timeless, polished look.

][133]
[

### Holt

Put together the modular seating of your dreams with pieces that feature, deep seats, an inviting
lower profile and solid wood base.

][134]
[

### Hopson

A staple collection for Mid-Century lovers, showcasing clean lines, subtle button tufting and angled
legs for added visual appeal.

][135]
[

### Hughes

Timeless and chic, the Hughes Collection brings the best of Mid-Century into your space with subtle
tufting, sleek lines, and effortless elegance.

][136]
[

### Korver

With its versatile frame, complete with chic button tufted back, the Korver Collection brings a
layer of retro elegance into your space.

][137]
[

### Levi

Slim profiles, high backs, and squared edges. The Levi Collection is a no-brainer for adding a touch
of MCM styling to your space.

][138]
[

### Lewis

The epitome of contemporary style, this beloved collection brings oversized profiles and overstuffed
plush cushions together for the ultimate way to lounge.

][139]
[

### Liam

Discover a timeless Chesterfield inspired collection, complete with cozy cushions and diamond tufted
detailing.

][140]
[

### Preston

The Preston Collection brings Mid-Century minimalism to any space with its clean lines and tailored
touches.

][141]
[

### Roddy

Refreshingly retro, the Roddy Collection features classic mid-century modern lines, button tufting,
and striking diagonal legs.

][142]
[

### Soto

Part furniture, part work of art, the Soto Collection brings strikingly modern sharp angles to any
space, sure to spark conversation.

][143]
[

### Denna

Become one with the pillows on this supremely cozy contemporary collection, practically overflowing
with plush seating and pillowed back options.

][144]
[

### Haine

Casually cool and infinitely welcoming, the pillow-topped Haine Collection was built for relaxing in
ultimate style.

][145]
[

### Arwen

Sleek and modern is the name of the game with this low slung, armless collection, perfect for
lounging.

][146]
[

### Daya

Lounge in contemporary style with this modular collection, filled with plush cushions, clean lines,
and endless possibilities of configurations.

][147]
[

### Bryant Petite

The ultimate in cloud-like comfort, the Bryant Petite Collection brings a pillow topped way to
lounge straight to your living room, in a smaller, apartment friendly size.

][148]
[

### Amelia

Inspired by the rounded furniture of the 70s, this collection boasts delicate curved angles with
plush, padded arms, for the comfiest lounging experience.

][149]
[

### Miller

Laidback, yet polished at the same time, the Miller collection boasts deep roomy cushions, slightly
angled arms, and an eye-catching wood base.

][150]
[

### Aime

This adaptable collection’s plethora of cushions, luxe gold legs, and chic Mid-Century profile make
it the perfect choice for design enthusiasts of all persuasions.

][151]
[

### Sebastian

Oozing with modern style, our Sebastian Collection offers seating of every size with rounded shelter
profiles, spacious seats, and pillowed backings that you can arrange and rearrange as you see fit.

][152]
[

### Holt Petite

Put together the modular seating of your dreams with pieces that feature deep seats, an inviting
lower profile and solid wood base, now available in a smaller size!

Strikingly modern, and oh-so-cozy, the Wilder Collection showcases plump cushions, pillowed backings

### Customer Testimonials
* "Simon was very helpful with the design of the laboratory, communication was good. Installation
  was quick and efficient. Very happy with the end result."
  
  Tessa Callow - Scientific Consultant, Scientific and Clinical Training and Education, Clinical
  Services NHS Blood and Transplant (Manchester)
* “We have worked with Klick on a rolling programme to refurbish 6 labs at the school. During the
  most recent project Klick provided a full science lab refurbishment service and acted as the
  principal contractor. Their contracts manager co-ordinated everything with expertise and made
  suggestions to reduce costs to keep to our budget. Everything was completed to schedule and the
  labs look absolutely amazing. I would happily recommend Klick to anyone.”
  
  Cath Wallace - Business Development Director, Corpus Christi Catholic High School, Preston
* Overall, I would highly recommend Klick to anyone looking for high-quality products and
  exceptional customer service. They have set the bar high for other suppliers in the industry, and
  I look forward to doing business with them again in the future.
  
  Senura Devage - Chartered Construction Manager, Synergy Construction and Property Consultants, re
  Carshalton High School for Girls
* "Once the brief was finalised Klick took ownership and completed everything efficiently and
  according to programme. Klick’s team were extremely professional throughout the project and simply
  got on with the job, they proactively raised any issues for discussion and were flexible in
  accommodating last minute changes. Having used the labs for a few months our technical team are
  impressed with the functionality and delighted to be working in an environment that ideally suits
  their needs."
  
  Dan Hamilton - Manager Failure Analysis, Characterisation, Testing and Simulation, AFC Energy PLC
* “Life Build employed Klick Technology for the FF&E on a recent project at Northwood College. They
  co-ordinated the product development and laboratory furniture installation for 9 laboratories in
  the new science block. Klick’s site team had a very positive mindset and were adaptable when
  working with other trades. They kept to the programme and the quality of their work is first
  class. The project went very well and the College are delighted with the end product. We will be
  talking to Klick about further collaborations.”
  
  Ric Thornhill, Construction Director - Life Build Solutions. Re Northwood College, London
* “Klick were involved from the early stages and developed the lab furniture design for Discovery
  Park’s world-class Incubator laboratories. During the construction phase Klick were always on hand
  with advice and information, even with elements of the project which didn’t necessarily directly
  involve them. On site Klick were very proactive with solutions and their installation team
  collaborated well with all the other trades. I can honestly say the whole experience with Klick
  from communication through to product has been fantastic. The final labs look great and Klick have
  achieved the ultimate in functionality.”
  
  Steve Mitchell – Project Manager, Discovery Park, Kent

  working with other trades. They kept to the programme and the quality of their work is first

  talking to Klick about further collaborations.”

### State of the art Veterinary Health Care Centre

Niti Bagh Pet Clinic is a well-established, full-service, small animal veterinary practice providing
comprehensive
pet medical, surgical and diagnostic care since 1990.

###### Veterinary OPD

Your pet is an important part of the family, and when they are ill, you want the best available
medical care. We are ready to provide your pet with comprehensive veterinary medical care - from
wellness exams and vaccines to parasite control and nutrition, your pet will receive the highest
quality care.

###### Diagnostics

At Niti Bagh Pet Clinic, we are equipped to provide the most current diagnostic, laboratory and
therapeutic services. We offer on-site x-rays, ultrasounds, electrocardiographs and other
diagnostics to care for your pets' complete health care needs.

###### Vaccinations & Deworming

Pets today can live longer, healthier lives than ever before—in part because of vaccines that help
protect them from deadly infectious diseases. The vets at Niti bagh Pet Clinic will administer the
vaccines and dewormings for your pets.

###### Treatment & Surgeries

We have state-of-the-art surgical facilities including spaying, neutering, mass removal, orthopedic
procedures and more. We utilize the safest available anesthetics to provide that extra margin of
safety, especially for our older or high risk patients.

### Niti Bagh Pet Clinic Veterinarians

The talented pool of Veterinarians, diverse in vet protocols, united in the pet care mission.
Niti Bagh Pet Clinic ensures that animal welfare standards are kept high by enabling veterinarians
to regularly attend CE programs.

[Find out more][213]

Designed with input from veterinary teams, VetIT
combines practical insight with smart technology
to help practices work more efficiently.

[Learn more][214]

Nothing’s quite as convenient as offering your patients
their treatment, without them needing to leave their
house. Our team can handle that for you.

[Learn more][215]

Welcome to our recovery area, designed specifically to support you in the care and rehabilitation of
pets.

[Visit the Hub][216]

For timely and accurate diagnostic services and
expert support that helps you make informed
clinical decisions, trust NationWide Laboratories.

[Learn more][217]

With everything you need in one place, you’re
free to focus on what you do best, delivering
care to your patients.

[Learn more][218]

As well as stocking major brands and providers, we’ve
developed a range of own-brand products,
designed to offer you maximum quality at a reasonable price.

[Explore Products][219]

Via NVS Online, our simple portal, or your PMS,
you can choose from over 14,000 daily and
specialist supplies.

[Learn more][220]

supplies.

“I got some of this quite a while ago and forgot I had it. I found it again when I was looking for

#### [Great product for actually gaining weight with visible results!][124]


 

“I typically don’t leave reviews unless a product is just that good or just that bad. This time it’s
just that great! Adds weight to my dobes and works fast. Don’t use too much if you’re dog is very

year old male who is in training and for lactating and females to build their weight up if they are
thin after having a litter. Works like a charm for me, dogs all eat it fine, no diarrhea, no side
effects and it’s a lot cheaper than the weight gainer powder I’ve been using for years. Two thumbs
up and many paws up as well!”

“I got some of this quite a while ago and forgot I had it. I found it again when I was looking for

dog loves it! The directions say to squirt it directly onto her tongue, which is not possible for
me, so I put the same amount on a little plate and she lapped it right up! It’s a great idea to keep
some at home to keep from paying emergency vet prices until you can take your dog to the vet when
they’re open.”

**Product:** [Pet Pectillin® Diarrhea Medication][123]

#### [Great product for actually gaining weight with visible results!][124]


 

“I typically don’t leave reviews unless a product is just that good or just that bad. This time it’s
just that great! Adds weight to my dobes and works fast. Don’t use too much if you’re dog is very
active or you’re working him or her otherwise you might just end up with a fat dog. I use it on my 1
year old male who is in training and for lactating and females to build their weight up if they are
thin after having a litter. Works like a charm for me, dogs all eat it fine, no diarrhea, no side
effects and it’s a lot cheaper than the weight gainer powder I’ve been using for years. Two thumbs
up and many paws up as well!”

Pet care FAQ

## Common questions from pet owners.

What should I bring to my pet's first appointment?
Please bring any prior veterinary records, vaccination history, and your pet's current medications
in their original packaging. If your pet is on a prescription diet, bring the bag or a photo of the
label. Arriving five minutes early gives us time to get your pet checked in and comfortable before
the exam.
Do you see both dogs and cats?
Yes. We care for dogs, cats, and small mammals including rabbits, guinea pigs, and ferrets. We do
not currently see birds, reptiles, or exotic species. Our team has advanced training in feline
medicine — we have a separate quiet waiting area for cats to reduce stress.
How do I book an appointment?
The easiest way is through our online portal — you can book any wellness visit, vaccine update, or
nail trim in under two minutes. For sick visits or urgent concerns, call us directly so we can
triage and find the earliest available slot. Same-day sick appointments are held each morning; call
before 9am.
What vaccinations does my dog or cat need?
For dogs, core vaccines include rabies, distemper-parvovirus (DA2PP), and bordetella. For cats, core
vaccines include rabies and FVRCP. Non-core vaccines like Leptospirosis, Lyme, or FeLV depend on
your pet's lifestyle and exposure risk. We will walk you through exactly what makes sense at your
wellness visit.
Do you offer payment plans?
We accept CareCredit and Scratchpay, both of which offer 0% interest plans for qualified applicants.
Applications take about three minutes at the front desk. We also accept all major credit cards,
debit, and cash. We do not offer in-house payment plans but will always discuss estimates before any
procedure.
What constitutes a pet emergency?
Seek emergency care immediately for: difficulty breathing, collapse or inability to stand, suspected
poisoning or toxin ingestion, seizures, severe vomiting or diarrhea (more than twice in an hour),
major trauma, eye injuries, or difficulty urinating. Our after-hours line connects you to a triage
nurse who can advise whether to wait or go to the emergency clinic.

Pet care FAQ

## Common questions from pet owners.

What should I bring to my pet's first appointment?
Please bring any prior veterinary records, vaccination history, and your pet's current medications
in their original packaging. If your pet is on a prescription diet, bring the bag or a photo of the
label. Arriving five minutes early gives us time to get your pet checked in and comfortable before
the exam.
Do you see both dogs and cats?
Yes. We care for dogs, cats, and small mammals including rabbits, guinea pigs, and ferrets. We do
not currently see birds, reptiles, or exotic species. Our team has advanced training in feline
medicine — we have a separate quiet waiting area for cats to reduce stress.
How do I book an appointment?
The easiest way is through our online portal — you can book any wellness visit, vaccine update, or
nail trim in under two minutes. For sick visits or urgent concerns, call us directly so we can
triage and find the earliest available slot. Same-day sick appointments are held each morning; call
before 9am.
What vaccinations does my dog or cat need?
For dogs, core vaccines include rabies, distemper-parvovirus (DA2PP), and bordetella. For cats, core
vaccines include rabies and FVRCP. Non-core vaccines like Leptospirosis, Lyme, or FeLV depend on
your pet's lifestyle and exposure risk. We will walk you through exactly what makes sense at your
wellness visit.
Do you offer payment plans?
We accept CareCredit and Scratchpay, both of which offer 0% interest plans for qualified applicants.
Applications take about three minutes at the front desk. We also accept all major credit cards,
debit, and cash. We do not offer in-house payment plans but will always discuss estimates before any
procedure.
What constitutes a pet emergency?
Seek emergency care immediately for: difficulty breathing, collapse or inability to stand, suspected
poisoning or toxin ingestion, seizures, severe vomiting or diarrhea (more than twice in an hour),
major trauma, eye injuries, or difficulty urinating. Our after-hours line connects you to a triage
nurse who can advise whether to wait or go to the emergency clinic.

## Our Story

### [Evolving with DJs since 1994]

For over 30 years, we've driven the evolution of DJ technology to expand creativity for artists
worldwide. Today, AlphaTheta draws on the DNA of Pioneer and Pioneer DJ, continuing our legacy of
innovation and engineering excellence.

In 1994, Pioneer launched the CDJ-500 – the world's first flat-top CD player with a turntable feel.
Combining digital precision with analog touch, it revolutionized DJing and marked the start of our
DJ business.

[1994][CDJ-500][145]

### [Defining the global club standard: CDJ & DJM series]

The CDJ and DJM series have defined the global club standard of DJ equipment for decades.In 2006,
the CDJ-1000MK3 achieved intuitive CD scratching through its exceptional jog wheel control, while
the DJM-800 introduced high-quality digital sound processing and more creative effects.Together,
they became the go-to setup for clubs around the world – shaping the experience of modern dance
music.

[CDJ-1000MK3][146]
[2006][DJM-800][147]

### [Expanding creative choices: DDJ & XDJ series]

As DJ culture evolved, so did we.In 2012, the DDJ-SX changed the game for controller DJs – combining
PC power and Serato software for a professional experience. In 2015, the XDJ-RX delivered
club-quality performance as a compact all-in-one device capable of playing tracks managed in
rekordbox directly from a USB drive.Both series continue to evolve – empowering DJs with new ways to
perform and express their creativity.

[2012][DDJ-SX][148]
[2015][XDJ-RX][149]

### [The next chapter: AlphaTheta]

In 2024, we launched our brand, AlphaTheta, to drive innovation.The rotary mixer, euphonia, delivers
an immersive sound that combines warmth and clarity, while the next-generation DJ player, the
CDJ-3000X, opens new horizons for professionals.From Pioneer to Pioneer DJ, and now to AlphaTheta,
our DNA of innovation and quality lives on.

[2024][euphonia][150]
[2025][CDJ-3000X][151]

## Our Story

### [Evolving with DJs since 1994]

For over 30 years, we've driven the evolution of DJ technology to expand creativity for artists
worldwide. Today, AlphaTheta draws on the DNA of Pioneer and Pioneer DJ, continuing our legacy of
innovation and engineering excellence.

In 1994, Pioneer launched the CDJ-500 – the world's first flat-top CD player with a turntable feel.
Combining digital precision with analog touch, it revolutionized DJing and marked the start of our
DJ business.

[1994][CDJ-500][145]

### [Defining the global club standard: CDJ & DJM series]

The CDJ and DJM series have defined the global club standard of DJ equipment for decades.In 2006,
the CDJ-1000MK3 achieved intuitive CD scratching through its exceptional jog wheel control, while
the DJM-800 introduced high-quality digital sound processing and more creative effects.Together,
they became the go-to setup for clubs around the world – shaping the experience of modern dance
music.

[CDJ-1000MK3][146]
[2006][DJM-800][147]

### [Expanding creative choices: DDJ & XDJ series]

As DJ culture evolved, so did we.In 2012, the DDJ-SX changed the game for controller DJs – combining
PC power and Serato software for a professional experience. In 2015, the XDJ-RX delivered
club-quality performance as a compact all-in-one device capable of playing tracks managed in
rekordbox directly from a USB drive.Both series continue to evolve – empowering DJs with new ways to
perform and express their creativity.

[2012][DDJ-SX][148]
[2015][XDJ-RX][149]

### [The next chapter: AlphaTheta]

In 2024, we launched our brand, AlphaTheta, to drive innovation.The rotary mixer, euphonia, delivers
an immersive sound that combines warmth and clarity, while the next-generation DJ player, the
CDJ-3000X, opens new horizons for professionals.From Pioneer to Pioneer DJ, and now to AlphaTheta,
our DNA of innovation and quality lives on.

[2024][euphonia][150]
[2025][CDJ-3000X][151]
[30 YEARS OF THE PIONEER DJ CDJ][152]
[[A DECADE OF PIONEER DJ IN IBIZA 2008-2018]][153]

a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. ## Better patient care starts with the right product

[ Contact us ][65]
Surgical Tables, Inc. offers mobile imaging tables for pain management, urology, vascular, ERCP, GI,
bariatric surgeries, veterinary imaging and more. Our made in the USA products are high quality and
made with care and come in a variety of price ranges to suit every customer’s needs.

Safety and Compliance. STI takes pride in the quality of the c-arm tables we make in house in
Massachusetts, USA.

[service]

Unmatched Customer Service. C-arm tables are the only business we are in, and we work hard to ensure
a flexible, stress free experience.

[versality]

custom tables.

### Why Telegram?

### Simple

**Telegram** is so simple you already know how to use it.

### Private

**Telegram** messages are heavily encrypted and can self-destruct.

### Synced

**Telegram** lets you access your chats from multiple devices.

### Fast

**Telegram** delivers messages faster than any other application.

### Powerful

**Telegram** has no limits on the size of your media and chats.

### Open

**Telegram** has an open [API][40] and source code free for everyone.

### Secure

**Telegram** keeps your messages safe from hacker attacks.

### Social

**Telegram** groups can hold up to 200,000 members.

### Expressive

**Telegram** lets you completely customize your messenger.

##### Telegram

Telegram is a cloud-based mobile and desktop messaging app with a focus on security and speed.

Technik is the UK’s leading suppliers of hygienic equipment for the veterinary sector. Our team is
passionate about providing clients with high-quality stainless steel products that optimise tasks
and enhance animal welfare.

With more than 23 years of experience, we are committed to providing our clients with expertly
designed animal welfare housing, veterinary equipment and hydrotherapy treadmills.

Whether it be a space re-fit or complete practice re-design Technik has a range of products that can
be configured to create the ideal veterinary workspace for you.

[ About us ][153]
[Dog 1]

## What are they saying about us?

**Technik were brilliant from start to finish with our kennel and prep room refit last year. With
help from David and his team they turned an old, tired kennel room into a modern, spacious and
really functional space that draws a "wow" from anyone who visits the practice. 

Technik custom-designed and then fitted our cat bank and dog kennels to use the available space most
efficiently. They offered their expert advice and then created scale drawings which helped us
visualise the design and identify, and then remedy, a couple of potential issues prior to
construction taking place. They were very patient and ensured we got things just right first time. 

Quality of the original product is excellent - as one would expect from quality British
manufacturing - and the fitting was performed with extreme care to get everything perfect. The
kennel doors are perfectly balanced (they just ooze quality) and even one year after heavy use we’ve
not had to adjust a thing. 

I would highly recommend their services. Top quality products and service.**

- Dr Tom Llewellyn MRCVS,
Clinical Director and Practice Partner, Forest Veterinary Clinic Ltd.
**From the very first assessment through to manufacture and installation, Technik provided excellent
customer service and delivered exactly what we needed. They supplied new glass-fronted caging with a
recycled solid core plastic pen. The difference is remarkable; the cages are fantastic! It’s such a
relief not to have the old wooden ones or the noisy, cold metal versions anymore.**

- Mel Duffy, Head of Operations,
Mousehole Wild Bird Hospital
**We absolutely love our kennels, and visitors have been very impressed with them.**

- Mark Lowrie, Director,
Movement Referrals: Independent Veterinary Specialists
**We’ve been using Technik’s products for 12 years, and their performance continues to be
exceptional. The quality has been consistently impressive, and we’re happy with both the products
and the long-lasting reliability they provide.**

- Carsten Glindø,
Managing Director, Fredrikstad Small Animal Hospital
**Technik worked closely with us to fully understand our needs, whilst also providing practical
advice that helped us make the most of our space. They struck an excellent balance between
maximising patient housing and maintaining a high level of comfort. From start to finish, the
process was smooth, considerate and highly accessible.**

- Ben Ogden, Practice Manager,
Ashlands Veterinary Centre
Ashlands Garth, Ashlands Road, Ilkley, LS29 8JT

can help you to transform your vision into a reality. We have the capability and the capacity to
manage projects of all sizes, including specialised veterinary refurbishments and

Initial assessments engaging with project team

Project plan, concept design and critical analysis

Design, development and prototyping

- Mel Duffy, Head of Operations,
Mousehole Wild Bird Hospital
**We absolutely love our kennels, and visitors have been very impressed with them.**

- Mark Lowrie, Director,
Movement Referrals: Independent Veterinary Specialists

exceptional. The quality has been consistently impressive, and we’re happy with both the products
and the long-lasting reliability they provide.**

- Carsten Glindø,

advice that helped us make the most of our space. They struck an excellent balance between
maximising patient housing and maintaining a high level of comfort. From start to finish, the
process was smooth, considerate and highly accessible.**

- Ben Ogden, Practice Manager,
Ashlands Veterinary Centre
Ashlands Garth, Ashlands Road, Ilkley, LS29 8JT

From initial assessments and concept design to installation, our highly skilled Projects Division
can help you to transform your vision into a reality. We have the capability and the capacity to
manage projects of all sizes, including specialised veterinary refurbishments and
multi-million-pound new builds.

Initial assessments engaging with project team

Project plan, concept design and critical analysis

Design, development and prototyping

#### Prepare, operate, wake up – all on one chair

## Surgery rotation

Make your OR management even more efficient and economical! The mobile treatment chairs from
UFSK-International OSYS were specially designed for time- and cost-saving surgery rotation. The use
of our medical treatment chairs enables the simultaneous treatment of several patients without the
need for additional time and energy for their repositioning. This means your patients can be
prepared and operated on in one chair – and wake up relaxed afterwards.

[
Mobile Table Rotation
][92]
[500 ECO treatment chair for IVOM]

#### Our treatment chair for walk-in OR concepts

## Just Walk-In OR

The rotation principle is already part of daily business in your OR? Then our [*500 ECO*][93]
treatment chair is the perfect addition to your OR system. Thanks to its high adjustment speed, the
treatment chair is ready for use in seconds and is thus ideally suited for intravitreal surgical
measures. This saves time and increases your average patient throughput for IVI treatments.

[
Just Walk-In OR
][94]
[Präventive Technologien am UFSK-OSYS Behandlungsstuhl eyeForce]

#### Preventing discomfort

## Preventive technologies

The higher the number of OR cycles, the more distance your staff has to cover every day. With the
ergonomic products of UFSK-International OSYS you sustainably relieve your staff and thus contribute
to improved productivity and  a lower level of sickness. The technical refinements of our transport
and treatment chairs enable a gentle working method and effectively improve the ability of your OR
staff to concentrate.

treatment chair is the perfect addition to your OR system. Thanks to its high adjustment speed, the
treatment chair is ready for use in seconds and is thus ideally suited for intravitreal surgical
measures. This saves time and increases your average patient throughput for IVI treatments.

Just Walk-In OR

## Preventive technologies

The higher the number of OR cycles, the more distance your staff has to cover every day. With the

# URBI ET ORBI | HANDMADE OBJECTS
# THAT REDEFINE CONCRETE DESIGN

URBI et ORBI is an Athens-based company producing handmade concrete objects inspired by
Mediterranean landscapes and cultures.
Rather than seeing it as a rigid industrial material, concrete is approached as a living mixture of
minerals and stories, shaped through craftsmanship and contemporary techniques into objects with a
strong cultural identity.
Collaborating with Greek and international designers, URBI et ORBI develops collections and bespoke
projects for domestic and hospitality spaces,
including furniture, washbasins, lighting, and accessories.

## PLASTICITY

### FREEDOM OF FORM

At first glance solid and immutable, concrete reveals its true nature as a fluid material shaped by
human intention and skill. Limited only by imagination, its plasticity allows it to take any form.

## MEDITERRANEO

### CLOSED SEA, OPEN VIEW

A unique way of life, the Mediterranean spirit is shaped by a multitude of cultural expressions,
emerging from its warm climate and diverse geographical morphology.
A past rich in historical, symbolic, and traditional references is reinterpreted through a
contemporary, innovative **[design language.][21]**

## LIFECYCLE

### FROM THE GROUND AND BACK

Composed of simple materials that come from the ground — rock, sand, and water — the mixture is
formed through the cohesion of cement, which constitutes only one tenth of its mass.
This creates an inert material that can be**[ reintegrated into the environment][22].**
Built for longevity yet capable of returning to its original elements, concrete ultimately finds its
way back to the ground.

[Urbi Et Orbi Concrete Objects]
[Urbi-et-Orbi-cement-objects]

## MATERIALS
## & PROCESSES

URBI ET ORBI creations result from expert craftsmanship that not only makes each piece unique, but
also pushes the boundaries of what concrete can express through its organic nature. The company
fosters close collaboration between designers and artisans, creating diverse and sustainable pieces
that blend traditional methods with contemporary thinking. All raw materials used are
internationally acknowledged and respect both the environment and the people who use them. 
**[Read more][23]**

## ZERO WASTE
## PROJECT BY
## URBI ET ORBI

What is usually called industrial waste, we call secondary raw materials – Ρecycled concrete
resources.

Concrete can be recycled infinitely, and we have made sustainable concrete recycling a natural part
of our production process in order to minimise our ecological footprint. We use locally sourced raw
materials, preferring sand collected from processing in our workshop rather than sand extracted
directly from nature.
As a result, we have achieved the recycling of 100% of our internal concrete production waste. To
highlight this commitment, in 2020 we launched a dedicated sustainability initiative called the
*Zero Waste Project*, repurposing our concrete waste through multiple design and production
processes. **[Read more][24]**

# URBI ET ORBI | HANDMADE OBJECTS
# THAT REDEFINE CONCRETE DESIGN

URBI et ORBI is an Athens-based company producing handmade concrete objects inspired by
Mediterranean landscapes and cultures.
Rather than seeing it as a rigid industrial material, concrete is approached as a living mixture of
minerals and stories, shaped through craftsmanship and contemporary techniques into objects with a
strong cultural identity.
Collaborating with Greek and international designers, URBI et ORBI develops collections and bespoke
projects for domestic and hospitality spaces,
including furniture, washbasins, lighting, and accessories.

## PLASTICITY

### FREEDOM OF FORM

At first glance solid and immutable, concrete reveals its true nature as a fluid material shaped by
human intention and skill. Limited only by imagination, its plasticity allows it to take any form.

## MEDITERRANEO

### CLOSED SEA, OPEN VIEW

A unique way of life, the Mediterranean spirit is shaped by a multitude of cultural expressions,
emerging from its warm climate and diverse geographical morphology.
A past rich in historical, symbolic, and traditional references is reinterpreted through a
contemporary, innovative **[design language.][21]**

## LIFECYCLE

### FROM THE GROUND AND BACK

Composed of simple materials that come from the ground — rock, sand, and water — the mixture is
formed through the cohesion of cement, which constitutes only one tenth of its mass.
This creates an inert material that can be**[ reintegrated into the environment][22].**
Built for longevity yet capable of returning to its original elements, concrete ultimately finds its
way back to the ground.

[Urbi Et Orbi Concrete Objects]
[Urbi-et-Orbi-cement-objects]

## MATERIALS
## & PROCESSES

URBI ET ORBI creations result from expert craftsmanship that not only makes each piece unique, but
also pushes the boundaries of what concrete can express through its organic nature. The company
fosters close collaboration between designers and artisans, creating diverse and sustainable pieces
that blend traditional methods with contemporary thinking. All raw materials used are
internationally acknowledged and respect both the environment and the people who use them. 
**[Read more][23]**

## ZERO WASTE
## PROJECT BY
## URBI ET ORBI

What is usually called industrial waste, we call secondary raw materials – Ρecycled concrete
resources.

Concrete can be recycled infinitely, and we have made sustainable concrete recycling a natural part
of our production process in order to minimise our ecological footprint. We use locally sourced raw
materials, preferring sand collected from processing in our workshop rather than sand extracted
directly from nature.
As a result, we have achieved the recycling of 100% of our internal concrete production waste. To
highlight this commitment, in 2020 we launched a dedicated sustainability initiative called the
*Zero Waste Project*, repurposing our concrete waste through multiple design and production
processes. **[Read more][24]**

Pets are our very good friends. A study, based on long research, has revealed that living with a pet
is beneficial for human health. However, we often fail to realize that these animals also need
medical attention, particularly when they get injured. Thus our pets, like human beings, need a
large number of veterinary/medical devices to keep them physically fit. It is a healthy sign that
for the last few years, a demand for veterinary implants & instruments has been growing steadily.
The Vet Ortho Division of GPC Medical Limited has a complete assortment of Veterinary Implants &
Instruments- PetVet. These are manufactured & supplied to veterinary universities, hospitals,
clinics & other healthcare centres worldwide.

## What is a Veterinary Specialist?

Veterinary specialists are veterinarians who have advanced training in various veterinary medical
and surgical disciplines and are Board-certified. To become Board-certified, a veterinarian must
have completed, at a minimum, four years of veterinary college, a one-year internship or equivalent,
and two to three years in a residency program that meets the standards of a recognized specialty
college or board. There are additional training and caseload requirements that must be met during
the residency and finally, to become an ACVIM Diplomate the veterinarian must pass a series of
rigorous examinations.

### Understanding The Veterinary Specialties For Animal Owners

Your primary veterinarian may refer you to a veterinary specialist for diagnosis and advanced
treatment if your pet is believed to have a medical condition that requires special care. Typically,
your referring primary veterinarian will work closely with the veterinary specialist to create a
treatment plan that will benefit your pet's specific needs. VetSpecialists.com is a resource for
animal owners to search for ACVIM Board-certified veterinary specialist

## VetSpecialists.com Mission and Vision

**Mission: **The VetSpecialists mission is to connect animal owners with Board-Certified veterinary
specialists who provide expert care in areas such as Cardiology, Large Animal Internal Medicine,
Neurology, Nutrition, Oncology, and Small Animal Internal Medicine. We are dedicated to fostering
awareness, education, and collaboration among animal owners, primary care veterinarians, and
specialists to ensure optimal health outcomes for animals.

**Vision: **Our vision for VetSpecialists is to be the leading advocate and resource for specialty
veterinary medicine, empowering animal owners and primary care veterinarians with the knowledge and
tools to access expert care when needed. We strive to enhance public awareness, promote
collaboration within the veterinary community, and improve the wellbeing of animals through
education and access to specialized care.




## About

VetSpecialists.com was developed by the American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine (ACVIM) to
provide education about diseases and conditions affecting animals and to increase awareness of
veterinary specialty medicine to the animal owning community.

## What is a Veterinary Specialist?

Veterinary specialists are veterinarians who have advanced training in various veterinary medical
and surgical disciplines and are Board-certified. To become Board-certified, a veterinarian must
have completed, at a minimum, four years of veterinary college, a one-year internship or equivalent,
and two to three years in a residency program that meets the standards of a recognized specialty
college or board. There are additional training and caseload requirements that must be met during
the residency and finally, to become an ACVIM Diplomate the veterinarian must pass a series of
rigorous examinations.

### Understanding The Veterinary Specialties For Animal Owners

Your primary veterinarian may refer you to a veterinary specialist for diagnosis and advanced
treatment if your pet is believed to have a medical condition that requires special care. Typically,
your referring primary veterinarian will work closely with the veterinary specialist to create a
treatment plan that will benefit your pet's specific needs. VetSpecialists.com is a resource for
animal owners to search for ACVIM Board-certified veterinary specialists in the six fields that are
offered: [Cardiology][56], [Large Animal Internal Medicine][57], [Neurology][58],
[Nutrition][59], [Oncology ][60]and [Small Animal Internal Medicine.][61]

## VetSpecialists.com Mission and Vision

**Mission: **The VetSpecialists mission is to connect animal owners with Board-Certified veterinary
specialists who provide expert care in areas such as Cardiology, Large Animal Internal Medicine,
Neurology, Nutrition, Oncology, and Small Animal Internal Medicine. We are dedicated to fostering
awareness, education, and collaboration among animal owners, primary care veterinarians, and
specialists to ensure optimal health outcomes for animals.

**Vision: **Our vision for VetSpecialists is to be the leading advocate and resource for specialty
veterinary medicine, empowering animal owners and primary care veterinarians with the knowledge and
tools to access expert care when needed. We strive to enhance public awareness, promote
collaboration within the veterinary community, and improve the wellbeing of animals through
education and access to specialized care.




## About

VetSpecialists.com was developed by the American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine (ACVIM) to
provide education about diseases and conditions affecting animals and to increase awareness of
veterinary specialty medicine to the animal owning community.

excellence to deliver meaningful innovation across medicines, vaccines, diagnostics,
biopharmaceuticals, and digital solutions.

[A fluffy dog stands on its hind legs greeting a seated colleague while other colleagues watch and

# Culture

Our colleagues around the globe are connected through an unwavering commitment to those we serve and
to one another. We've built an award-winning workplace where people feel valued, included,
supported, and proud—living our Core Beliefs every day as we advance animal health and well-being in
over 100 countries.

[Learn More][115]
[Underwater scene with a school of Pangasius fish swimming through clear blue water - Zoetis]

# Sustainability

We are committed to championing a healthier, more sustainable future. One that benefits our
communities, animals and the planet we share. Through our Driven to Care approach, we strive to be
the most sustainable animal health company and create a healthier world for all.

[Learn More][116]
[Group of Zoetis scientists in white lab coats and safety glasses chatting and smiling in a bright
laboratory corridor - Zoetis]

INNOVATORS FOR ANIMALS

# Real Stories, Revolutionary Science

Discover the stories behind our science. Innovators for Animals showcases the veterinarians,
livestock producers, researchers, and purpose-driven colleagues creating life-changing results for
animals and the people who care for them.

[Learn More][117]

[Family in meadow with cattle - Zoetis]

### Welcome to Zoetis

As the world’s leading animal health company, Zoetis is driven by a singular purpose: to nurture our
world and humankind by advancing care for animals. 

With a legacy of nearly 75 years, Zoetis continues to pioneer ways to predict, prevent, detect, and
treat animal illness, supporting veterinarians, livestock producers, and pet owners in over 100
countries.  

We integrate deep scientific expertise, data-driven R&D, advanced manufacturing, and commercial
excellence to deliver meaningful innovation across medicines, vaccines, diagnostics,
biopharmaceuticals, and digital solutions.  

Guided by our vision to be the most trusted and valued animal health company, Zoetis is committed to
setting new standards for the future of animal care through innovation, customer obsession, and
purpose-driven colleagues.
